towers.description: 400 floors. Moss, stone, sand and obsidian as you climb.
250 floors of ice. Slippery, and it never lets up.
300 floors. Narrow, fast, and full of trampolines.
320 floors of flooded copper. Verdigris, moss, then obsidian dark.
350 floors of pale stone. Tall, narrow, and it does not slow down.
500 floors in the dark. The longest climb in the game.
